statements:
CREATE TABLE workspaces (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      display_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(display_name)) > 0),
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE clients (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
      display_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(display_name)) > 0),
      contact_phone TEXT,
      contact_email TEXT,
      lifecycle TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (lifecycle IN ('ACTIVE','ARCHIVED')),
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision > 0),
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      archived_at TEXT, birth_date TEXT, height_cm_x10 INTEGER CHECK (height_cm_x10 IS NULL OR height_cm_x10 > 0), emoji TEXT, sex TEXT CHECK (sex IS NULL OR sex IN ('MALE','FEMALE')),
      CHECK ((lifecycle = 'ACTIVE' AND archived_at IS NULL)
        OR (lifecycle = 'ARCHIVED' AND archived_at IS NOT NULL))
    )

CREATE TABLE client_recovery_drafts (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
      client_id TEXT,
      mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('create','edit')),
      base_client_revision INTEGER,
      questionnaire_revision TEXT,
      draft_schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (draft_schema_version > 0),
      form_data_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(form_data_json)),
      questionnaire_answers_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(questionnaire_answers_json)),
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      CHECK ((mode = 'create' AND client_id IS NULL AND base_client_revision IS NULL)
        OR (mode = 'edit' AND client_id IS NOT NULL AND base_client_revision > 0)),
      FOREIGN KEY (client_id, workspace_id)
        REFERENCES clients(id, workspace_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
    )

CREATE TABLE client_activity (
      workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      last_opened_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, client_id),
      FOREIGN KEY (client_id, workspace_id)
        REFERENCES clients(id, workspace_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
    )

CREATE TABLE roster_preferences (
      workspace_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
      sort_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (sort_mode IN ('NAME','RECENT'))
    , birthday_pin_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (birthday_pin_enabled IN (0,1)), birthday_pin_lead_days INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 14 CHECK (birthday_pin_lead_days BETWEEN 1 AND 60), show_birthday_badge INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (show_birthday_badge IN (0,1)), archive_sort_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ARCHIVED_AT' CHECK (archive_sort_mode IN ('ARCHIVED_AT','NAME')))

CREATE TABLE birthday_dismissals (
      workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      occurrence_date TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, client_id, occurrence_date),
      FOREIGN KEY (client_id, workspace_id)
        REFERENCES clients(id, workspace_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
    )
CREATE INDEX clients_roster ON clients(workspace_id, lifecycle, display_name, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX clients_id_workspace ON clients(id, workspace_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX draft_create_one ON client_recovery_drafts(workspace_id) WHERE mode = 'create'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX draft_edit_one ON client_recovery_drafts(workspace_id, client_id) WHERE mode = 'edit'
CREATE INDEX draft_updated ON client_recovery_drafts(updated_at)
CREATE INDEX client_activity_recent ON client_activity(workspace_id, last_opened_at DESC)

CREATE TRIGGER clients_scope_fixed BEFORE UPDATE OF id, workspace_id ON clients
    WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.workspace_id IS NOT OLD.workspace_id
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'OWNER_SCOPE_IMMUTABLE'); END

CREATE TABLE session_types (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
      seed_key TEXT,
      name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0),
      category TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (category IN ('TRAINING','INSTRUCTION','CONSULTATION','OTHER')),
      default_duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL
        CHECK (default_duration_minutes > 0 AND default_duration_minutes % 30 = 0),
      requires_credit INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (requires_credit IN (0,1)),
      archived_at TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL, color TEXT
      CHECK (color IS NULL OR color IN ('teal','blue','violet','amber','rose','slate')),
      UNIQUE (workspace_id, seed_key)
    )

CREATE TABLE calendar_settings (
      workspace_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
      day_start_minute INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 420
        CHECK (day_start_minute >= 0 AND day_start_minute % 30 = 0),
      day_end_minute INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1380
        CHECK (day_end_minute <= 1440 AND day_end_minute % 30 = 0),
      visible_weekdays TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '1111111'
        CHECK (length(visible_weekdays) = 7 AND visible_weekdays NOT GLOB '*[^01]*'
          AND instr(visible_weekdays, '1') > 0),
      default_session_type_id TEXT,
      copy_appointments INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (copy_appointments IN (0,1)),
      copy_duty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (copy_duty IN (0,1)),
      copy_blocked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (copy_blocked IN (0,1)),
      clear_appointments INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (clear_appointments IN (0,1)),
      clear_duty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (clear_duty IN (0,1)),
      clear_blocked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (clear_blocked IN (0,1)), undo_cancel_prompt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
      CHECK (undo_cancel_prompt IN (0,1)),
      CHECK (day_end_minute - day_start_minute >= 30),
      FOREIGN KEY (default_session_type_id, workspace_id)
        REFERENCES session_types(id, workspace_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
    )

CREATE TABLE calendar_appointments (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
      local_date TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (date(local_date) IS local_date),
      start_minute INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (start_minute >= 0 AND start_minute % 30 = 0),
      duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (duration_minutes > 0 AND duration_minutes % 30 = 0),
      client_id TEXT,
      guest_name TEXT,
      participant_deleted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (participant_deleted IN (0,1)),
      session_type_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      session_type_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      session_type_category TEXT NOT NULL,
      session_type_requires_credit INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (session_type_requires_credit IN (0,1)),
      note TEXT,
      lifecycle TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (lifecycle IN ('SCHEDULED','COMPLETED','CANCELLED')),
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision > 0),
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      cancelled_at TEXT, credit_bypass INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (credit_bypass IN (0,1)), outcome TEXT
      CHECK (outcome IS NULL OR outcome IN ('COMPLETED','MISSED','CANCELLED')), outcome_at TEXT,
      CHECK (start_minute + duration_minutes <= 1440),
      CHECK ((client_id IS NOT NULL AND guest_name IS NULL AND participant_deleted = 0)
        OR (client_id IS NULL AND guest_name IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(guest_name)) > 0
          AND participant_deleted = 0)
        OR (client_id IS NULL AND guest_name IS NULL AND participant_deleted = 1)),
      CHECK ((lifecycle = 'CANCELLED') = (cancelled_at IS NOT NULL)),
      FOREIGN KEY (client_id, workspace_id)
        REFERENCES clients(id, workspace_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
      FOREIGN KEY (session_type_id, workspace_id)
        REFERENCES session_types(id, workspace_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
    )

CREATE TABLE calendar_intervals (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
      kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('DUTY','BLOCKED')),
      local_date TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (date(local_date) IS local_date),
      start_minute INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (start_minute >= 0 AND start_minute % 30 = 0),
      end_minute INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (end_minute <= 1440 AND end_minute % 30 = 0),
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      CHECK (end_minute > start_minute)
    )
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX session_types_id_workspace ON session_types(id, workspace_id)
CREATE INDEX appointments_day ON calendar_appointments(workspace_id, local_date, start_minute)

CREATE INDEX appointments_client ON calendar_appointments(workspace_id, client_id)
      WHERE client_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX intervals_day ON calendar_intervals(workspace_id, local_date, start_minute)

CREATE TRIGGER appointments_outcome_insert BEFORE INSERT ON calendar_appointments
      WHEN NOT (CASE NEW.lifecycle
  WHEN 'SCHEDULED' THEN NEW.outcome IS NULL
  WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN COALESCE(NEW.outcome IN ('COMPLETED','MISSED'), 0)
  ELSE NEW.outcome IS NULL OR NEW.outcome IS 'CANCELLED' END)
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'CALENDAR_OUTCOME_LIFECYCLE_MISMATCH'); END

CREATE TRIGGER appointments_outcome_update
      BEFORE UPDATE OF lifecycle, outcome ON calendar_appointments
      WHEN NOT (CASE NEW.lifecycle
  WHEN 'SCHEDULED' THEN NEW.outcome IS NULL
  WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN COALESCE(NEW.outcome IN ('COMPLETED','MISSED'), 0)
  ELSE NEW.outcome IS NULL OR NEW.outcome IS 'CANCELLED' END)
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'CALENDAR_OUTCOME_LIFECYCLE_MISMATCH'); END

CREATE TABLE accounting_settings (
      workspace_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
      default_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNTRACKED'
        CHECK (default_mode IN ('FITCOACH','EXTERNAL','UNTRACKED'))
    )

CREATE TABLE client_accounting (
      workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('FITCOACH','EXTERNAL','UNTRACKED')),
      PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, client_id),
      FOREIGN KEY (client_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES clients(id, workspace_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
    )

CREATE TABLE session_packs (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      title TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title)) > 0),
      credit_scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (credit_scope IN ('GENERAL','SESSION_TYPE')),
      session_type_id TEXT,
      session_type_name TEXT,
      granted_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (granted_count > 0),
      total_kopeks INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (total_kopeks >= 0),
      expires_on TEXT CHECK (expires_on IS NULL OR date(expires_on) IS expires_on),
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      CHECK ((credit_scope = 'GENERAL' AND session_type_id IS NULL AND session_type_name IS NULL)
        OR (credit_scope = 'SESSION_TYPE' AND session_type_id IS NOT NULL AND session_type_name IS NOT NULL)),
      FOREIGN KEY (client_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES clients(id, workspace_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
      FOREIGN KEY (session_type_id, workspace_id)
        REFERENCES session_types(id, workspace_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
    )

CREATE TABLE credit_ledger (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      pack_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      appointment_id TEXT REFERENCES calendar_appointments(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
      source_entry_id TEXT REFERENCES credit_ledger(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
      entry_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (entry_type IN ('ISSUED','USED','RETURNED','ADJUSTMENT')),
      delta INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (delta <> 0),
      reason TEXT,
      operation_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      CHECK ((entry_type = 'ISSUED' AND delta > 0 AND appointment_id IS NULL)
        OR (entry_type = 'USED' AND delta = -1 AND appointment_id IS NOT NULL)
        OR (entry_type = 'RETURNED' AND delta = 1 AND source_entry_id IS NOT NULL)
        OR (entry_type = 'ADJUSTMENT' AND reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(reason)) > 0)),
      FOREIGN KEY (pack_id, workspace_id, client_id)
        REFERENCES session_packs(id, workspace_id, client_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
    )

CREATE TABLE credit_reservations (
      appointment_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES calendar_appointments(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
      workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      pack_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      ends_on TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (date(ends_on) IS ends_on),
      ends_minute INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ends_minute BETWEEN 1 AND 1440),
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY (pack_id, workspace_id, client_id)
        REFERENCES session_packs(id, workspace_id, client_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
    )

CREATE TABLE payment_records (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      pack_id TEXT,
      amount_kopeks INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_kopeks > 0),
      paid_on TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (date(paid_on) IS paid_on),
      method TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('transfer','cash','other')),
      note TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY (client_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES clients(id, workspace_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
      FOREIGN KEY (pack_id, workspace_id, client_id)
        REFERENCES session_packs(id, workspace_id, client_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
    )

CREATE TABLE client_preferred_packs (
      workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      pack_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, client_id),
      FOREIGN KEY (client_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES clients(id, workspace_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
      FOREIGN KEY (pack_id, workspace_id, client_id) REFERENCES session_packs(id, workspace_id, client_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
    )
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX session_packs_owner ON session_packs(id, workspace_id, client_id)
CREATE INDEX session_packs_client ON session_packs(workspace_id, client_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX credit_ledger_pack ON credit_ledger(workspace_id, pack_id)
CREATE INDEX credit_ledger_appointment ON credit_ledger(appointment_id) WHERE appointment_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX credit_reservations_due ON credit_reservations(workspace_id, ends_on, ends_minute)
CREATE INDEX credit_reservations_pack ON credit_reservations(workspace_id, pack_id)
CREATE INDEX payment_records_client ON payment_records(workspace_id, client_id, paid_on)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX credit_ledger_one_return ON credit_ledger(source_entry_id) WHERE entry_type = 'RETURNED'

CREATE TRIGGER credit_ledger_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON credit_ledger
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ACCOUNTING_LEDGER_APPEND_ONLY'); END

CREATE TRIGGER credit_ledger_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON credit_ledger
      WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounting_purge WHERE client_id = OLD.client_id)
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ACCOUNTING_LEDGER_APPEND_ONLY'); END

CREATE TRIGGER credit_ledger_return_source BEFORE INSERT ON credit_ledger
      WHEN NEW.entry_type = 'RETURNED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credit_ledger AS s
        WHERE s.id = NEW.source_entry_id AND s.pack_id = NEW.pack_id AND s.client_id = NEW.client_id
          AND s.delta = -1 AND s.entry_type IN ('USED','ADJUSTMENT'))
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ACCOUNTING_RETURN_SOURCE_INVALID'); END
CREATE TEMP TABLE d01_accounting_preflight (ok INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ok = 1))

INSERT INTO d01_accounting_preflight SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credit_reservations AS existing
      WHERE NOT COALESCE((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM calendar_appointments AS appointment
  WHERE appointment.id = existing.appointment_id AND appointment.workspace_id = existing.workspace_id AND appointment.client_id = existing.client_id)), 0))

INSERT INTO d01_accounting_preflight SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credit_ledger AS existing
      WHERE NOT COALESCE(((existing.appointment_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM calendar_appointments AS appointment
  WHERE appointment.id = existing.appointment_id AND appointment.workspace_id = existing.workspace_id))
  AND (existing.source_entry_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credit_ledger AS source
    WHERE source.id = existing.source_entry_id AND source.workspace_id = existing.workspace_id
      AND source.client_id = existing.client_id AND source.pack_id = existing.pack_id))), 0))
DROP TABLE d01_accounting_preflight

CREATE TRIGGER credit_reservations_owner_insert
    BEFORE INSERT ON credit_reservations WHEN NOT COALESCE((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM calendar_appointments AS appointment
  WHERE appointment.id = NEW.appointment_id AND appointment.workspace_id = NEW.workspace_id AND appointment.client_id = NEW.client_id)), 0)
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'OWNER_ACCOUNTING_REFERENCE'); END

CREATE TRIGGER credit_reservations_owner_update
    BEFORE UPDATE ON credit_reservations WHEN NOT COALESCE((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM calendar_appointments AS appointment
  WHERE appointment.id = NEW.appointment_id AND appointment.workspace_id = NEW.workspace_id AND appointment.client_id = NEW.client_id)), 0)
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'OWNER_ACCOUNTING_REFERENCE'); END

CREATE TRIGGER credit_ledger_owner_insert
    BEFORE INSERT ON credit_ledger WHEN NOT COALESCE(((NEW.appointment_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM calendar_appointments AS appointment
  WHERE appointment.id = NEW.appointment_id AND appointment.workspace_id = NEW.workspace_id))
  AND (NEW.source_entry_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credit_ledger AS source
    WHERE source.id = NEW.source_entry_id AND source.workspace_id = NEW.workspace_id
      AND source.client_id = NEW.client_id AND source.pack_id = NEW.pack_id))), 0)
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'OWNER_ACCOUNTING_REFERENCE'); END

CREATE TRIGGER credit_ledger_owner_update
    BEFORE UPDATE ON credit_ledger WHEN NOT COALESCE(((NEW.appointment_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM calendar_appointments AS appointment
  WHERE appointment.id = NEW.appointment_id AND appointment.workspace_id = NEW.workspace_id))
  AND (NEW.source_entry_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credit_ledger AS source
    WHERE source.id = NEW.source_entry_id AND source.workspace_id = NEW.workspace_id
      AND source.client_id = NEW.client_id AND source.pack_id = NEW.pack_id))), 0)
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'OWNER_ACCOUNTING_REFERENCE'); END

CREATE TRIGGER appointment_reserved_owner_fixed BEFORE UPDATE OF id, workspace_id, client_id ON calendar_appointments
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credit_reservations AS reservation WHERE reservation.appointment_id = OLD.id
        AND (NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR reservation.workspace_id IS NOT NEW.workspace_id OR reservation.client_id IS NOT NEW.client_id))
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'OWNER_ACCOUNTING_REFERENCE'); END

CREATE TRIGGER appointment_ledger_scope_fixed BEFORE UPDATE OF id, workspace_id ON calendar_appointments
      WHEN (NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.workspace_id IS NOT OLD.workspace_id)
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credit_ledger WHERE appointment_id = OLD.id)
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'OWNER_ACCOUNTING_REFERENCE'); END

CREATE TABLE "body_measurements" (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('WEIGHT','BODY_FAT','NECK','SHOULDERS','CHEST','WAIST','HIPS','ARM','THIGH','CALF','ABDOMEN','ARM_L','ARM_R','FOREARM_L','FOREARM_R','THIGH_L','THIGH_R','CALF_L','CALF_R')),
      value_x10 INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (value_x10 > 0),
      local_date TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (date(local_date) IS local_date),
      local_minute INTEGER CHECK (local_minute IS NULL OR local_minute BETWEEN 0 AND 1439),
      method TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('MANUAL','NAVY_ESTIMATE')),
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision > 0),
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY (client_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES clients(id, workspace_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
    )

CREATE TABLE "measurement_daily_primary" (
      workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      type TEXT NOT NULL,
      local_date TEXT NOT NULL,
      measurement_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, client_id, type, local_date),
      FOREIGN KEY (measurement_id, workspace_id, client_id, type, local_date)
        REFERENCES "body_measurements"(id, workspace_id, client_id, type, local_date) ON DELETE RESTRICT
    )
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX body_measurements_identity_v2 ON "body_measurements"(id, workspace_id, client_id, type, local_date)
CREATE INDEX body_measurements_series_v2 ON "body_measurements"(workspace_id, client_id, type, local_date)

CREATE TABLE recipes (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80),
      servings_x10 INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (servings_x10 > 0),
      cooked_mass_x10 INTEGER CHECK (cooked_mass_x10 IS NULL OR cooked_mass_x10 > 0),
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision > 0),
      archived_at TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    , description TEXT CHECK (description IS NULL OR length(description) BETWEEN 1 AND 500), favorite INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (favorite IN (0, 1)), in_cookbook INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (in_cookbook IN (0, 1)), details_json TEXT CHECK (details_json IS NULL OR json_valid(details_json)))

CREATE TABLE water_days (
      workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      local_date TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (date(local_date) IS local_date),
      ml INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ml > 0 AND ml <= 20000),
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, client_id, local_date),
      FOREIGN KEY (client_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES clients(id, workspace_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
    )

CREATE TABLE nutrition_target_versions (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      effective_from TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (date(effective_from) IS effective_from),
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision > 0),
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, home_adjustment_json TEXT
      CHECK (home_adjustment_json IS NULL OR json_valid(home_adjustment_json)),
      UNIQUE (workspace_id, client_id, effective_from),
      FOREIGN KEY (client_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES clients(id, workspace_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
    )

CREATE TABLE nutrition_target_days (
      version_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      weekday INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (weekday BETWEEN 0 AND 6),
      kcal_min_x10 INTEGER CHECK (kcal_min_x10 IS NULL OR kcal_min_x10 >= 0),
      kcal_max_x10 INTEGER CHECK (kcal_max_x10 IS NULL OR kcal_max_x10 >= kcal_min_x10), protein_min_x10 INTEGER CHECK (protein_min_x10 IS NULL OR protein_min_x10 >= 0),
      protein_max_x10 INTEGER CHECK (protein_max_x10 IS NULL OR protein_max_x10 >= protein_min_x10), fat_min_x10 INTEGER CHECK (fat_min_x10 IS NULL OR fat_min_x10 >= 0),
      fat_max_x10 INTEGER CHECK (fat_max_x10 IS NULL OR fat_max_x10 >= fat_min_x10), carbs_min_x10 INTEGER CHECK (carbs_min_x10 IS NULL OR carbs_min_x10 >= 0),
      carbs_max_x10 INTEGER CHECK (carbs_max_x10 IS NULL OR carbs_max_x10 >= carbs_min_x10),
      PRIMARY KEY (version_id, weekday),
      CHECK ((kcal_min_x10 IS NULL) = (kcal_max_x10 IS NULL)), CHECK ((protein_min_x10 IS NULL) = (protein_max_x10 IS NULL)), CHECK ((fat_min_x10 IS NULL) = (fat_max_x10 IS NULL)), CHECK ((carbs_min_x10 IS NULL) = (carbs_max_x10 IS NULL)),
      FOREIGN KEY (version_id) REFERENCES nutrition_target_versions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    )

CREATE TABLE nutrition_target_exceptions (
      workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      local_date TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (date(local_date) IS local_date),
      kcal_min_x10 INTEGER CHECK (kcal_min_x10 IS NULL OR kcal_min_x10 >= 0),
      kcal_max_x10 INTEGER CHECK (kcal_max_x10 IS NULL OR kcal_max_x10 >= kcal_min_x10), protein_min_x10 INTEGER CHECK (protein_min_x10 IS NULL OR protein_min_x10 >= 0),
      protein_max_x10 INTEGER CHECK (protein_max_x10 IS NULL OR protein_max_x10 >= protein_min_x10), fat_min_x10 INTEGER CHECK (fat_min_x10 IS NULL OR fat_min_x10 >= 0),
      fat_max_x10 INTEGER CHECK (fat_max_x10 IS NULL OR fat_max_x10 >= fat_min_x10), carbs_min_x10 INTEGER CHECK (carbs_min_x10 IS NULL OR carbs_min_x10 >= 0),
      carbs_max_x10 INTEGER CHECK (carbs_max_x10 IS NULL OR carbs_max_x10 >= carbs_min_x10),
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, client_id, local_date),
      CHECK ((kcal_min_x10 IS NULL) = (kcal_max_x10 IS NULL)), CHECK ((protein_min_x10 IS NULL) = (protein_max_x10 IS NULL)), CHECK ((fat_min_x10 IS NULL) = (fat_max_x10 IS NULL)), CHECK ((carbs_min_x10 IS NULL) = (carbs_max_x10 IS NULL)),
      FOREIGN KEY (client_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES clients(id, workspace_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
    )

CREATE TABLE nutrition_calc_profiles (
      workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      goal TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (goal IN ('LOSS','MAINTENANCE','GAIN')),
      activity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (activity IN ('SEDENTARY','MODERATE','ACTIVE','VERY_ACTIVE')),
      workouts_per_week INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (workouts_per_week BETWEEN 0 AND 21),
      workout_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (workout_minutes BETWEEN 1 AND 600),
      intensity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (intensity IN ('LIGHT','MEDIUM','HEAVY')),
      step_kcal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (step_kcal BETWEEN 0 AND 1000),
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision > 0),
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, client_id),

      workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,

      load_grams INTEGER CHECK (load_grams IS NULL OR load_grams BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000),
      duration_sec INTEGER CHECK (duration_sec IS NULL OR duration_sec BETWEEN 1 AND 86400),
      distance_m INTEGER CHECK (distance_m IS NULL OR distance_m BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000), reps_max INTEGER

CREATE TABLE training_mesocycles (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      program_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      lineage_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (position >= 0),
      title TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80),
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL, cycle_type TEXT
      CHECK (CASE WHEN cycle_type IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE cycle_type IN ('hypertrophy','strength','power','endurance','recomp','custom') END), rep_min INTEGER
      CHECK (CASE WHEN rep_min IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE rep_min BETWEEN 1 AND 100 END), rep_max INTEGER
      CHECK (CASE WHEN rep_max IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN rep_min IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE rep_max BETWEEN rep_min AND 100 END), start_date TEXT

      CHECK (CASE WHEN group_left_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE length(group_left_at) > 0 END),

      UNIQUE (workspace_id, program_id, client_id, lineage_id),

      SELECT m.workspace_id, 'copy:' || m.lineage_id FROM training_mesocycles m

      WHERE m.group_left_at IS NULL
      GROUP BY m.workspace_id, m.lineage_id HAVING count(*) = count(DISTINCT m.client_id)

      occurs_at TEXT NOT NULL,

      dismissed_at TEXT,

CREATE TRIGGER notification_events_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON notification_events
      WHEN NEW.id <> OLD.id OR NEW.workspace_id <> OLD.workspace_id OR NEW.source_type <> OLD.source_type OR NEW.source_id <> OLD.source_id
        OR NEW.event_kind <> OLD.event_kind OR NEW.event_version <> OLD.event_version OR NEW.occurs_at <> OLD.occurs_at
        OR NEW.title <> OLD.title OR NEW.body <> OLD.body OR COALESCE(NEW.client_id, '') <> COALESCE(OLD.client_id, '')
        OR (OLD.read_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.read_at IS NULL)
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'NOTIFICATION_EVENT_IMMUTABLE'); END
